# `trace`

Helper: `trace(run, ...)`, run `{ label, toggle, open, steps: [{ n, finish, tokens, parts: [{ label, text, mono }] }] }`  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap (`TracePane`: one `Button` per run, steps with labelled text and code) · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): none

## Anatomy

One header button per run ("Xem" / "Thu gọn"), and for an open run its steps: finish reason, tokens in/out, tool call (mono), tool answer, model text.

## Variants

- Closed run
- Open run with steps

## States

- Open: header on table-head fill with a line under it

## Tokens

surface, line, table-head, field, ink, ink-soft, radius-card, radius-tile

## Do

- Show raw tool call and answer in monospace

## Don't

- Do not show personal data; the canvas uses synthetic text

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Web-only.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

**web-only.** The agent's runs: a header button per run (`label` is the old button text, `toggle` 'Xem' or 'Thu gọn') and, for an open run, its steps with the finish reason, tokens in / out, the tool call (`mono`: code), the tool answer and what the model said. Used by Trace agent (WJ94-WJ97) and the session detail (WJ17)
